name: @w6w-apps/ontraport
description: Manage contacts, tasks, tags, campaigns, sequences and orders in Ontraport's CRM and marketing automation platform.

w6w.longDescription:
Ontraport is a CRM and marketing automation platform built around one generic "Object" model: every record — a contact, a task, a tag, an order — is an instance of a numbered object type (a contact is object type 0, a task is object type 1, and so on), and the API exposes both a generic `/objects` family that takes that number as a parameter and dedicated per-object endpoints (`/Contact`, `/Contacts`, `/Task`, `/Tags`, …) that don't.

This app covers the core CRM path over the dedicated endpoints: full CRUD on contacts, plus merge-by-email; reading and life-cycle-managing tasks (Ontraport's own permission table refuses task creation and deletion through the API entirely — only read, update, assign, cancel, complete and reschedule exist); full CRUD on tags plus tagging/untagging any object by name; read access to campaigns (Ontraport's automations) and sequences; and read (plus delete, where documented) access to orders, transactions and purchases.

Every path, parameter and object-type number here was verified against Ontraport's own API reference at api.ontraport.com/doc, cross-checked with live probes against api.ontraport.com and the vendor's Statuspage instance.
